description:
Implement the approved full lifecycle: discover upstream final releases; mechanically prepare/resume fork PR; protected exact-head fork merge after required CI; require all canonical push-main checks at merge SHA; consume exact verified wheel artifact; transactionally prepare restricted BenchBox adoption; substantively review actual upstream/fork source delta at consumer adoption; run execution/installed-package gates; land through existing pr-arm; confirm develop pin/hash. Stateless hourly/manual reconciliation, one active consumer adoption, fresh checks before mutations, explicit failure fingerprints and actionable exception issues, no routine human merge/build/adopt commands.

Prior art: scripts/sqlglot_fork_refresh.py; scripts/adopt_sqlglot_wheel.py; .github/workflows/sqlglot-fork-refresh.yml; fork downstream.refresh auto and three push-main workflows; existing source promotion primitives now owned by the pinned Theseus reviewer; existing make pr-arm and bot REST publication. Extend these, no new service/database/reviewer clone.

Decision gates: source-aware reviewer must be deployed before activation; Q19 reliability fixed; App/write credential provenance/permissions verified; owner-only credentials and enable variable cannot be invented; actual first eligible release remains separate empirical certification.
